title: Steampunk Bull Rider
description: A stern man with a mustache and top hat adorned with horns rides a large brown bull covered in dripping colorful glowing orbs. The bull stands on a wet cobblestone street littered with discarded top hats and wagon wheels, set against a dramatic swirling cosmic sky filled with vibrant floating orbs and colorful smoke.
prompt: A stern Victorian man with a mustache wearing a black top hat with horns and a dark steampunk coat rides a massive brown bull. The bull is covered in dripping glowing colorful orbs in pink, purple, green and blue. They stand on wet cobblestone ground scattered with top hats and broken wagon wheels. Dramatic swirling orange and purple cosmic sky filled with floating luminous orbs and colorful smoke trails, highly detailed surreal fantasy scene.
